data.title: 伽玛 · 四越银行金库巡查
data.description: 四越银行地下金库，成排的金币与魔石在柜门后闪光。伽玛逐项核对封存清单，数字在她脑中自动成账，分毫不差。
data.location: underground bank vault with rows of gold coins, gemstones and sealed deposit cabinets
data.action: checking a sealed inventory list with a key in hand, standing before open vault cabinets, serious expression
data.lighting: 金库魔石灯的冷金色光辉
data.promptProse: Inside the Mitsugoshi Bank vault, Gamma verifies every seal and figure; not a single coin escapes her arithmetic.
data.animaCaption: Gold beyond counting, and Gamma knows the count to the last coin.
